description: 17-field structured extraction schema for MCI progression papers

fields.description: Stable unique identifier derived from filename or DOI slug

Data-domain taxonomy v2 (method lives in Architecture_Family, not here). C1=Neuroimaging (MRI/fMRI/DTI/PET); C2=Electrophysiology (EEG/MEG/ERP/fNIRS); C3=Molecular/Fluid (CSF/plasma/genomics/omics); C4=Behavioural/Digital (speech/language/gait/eye/handwriting/sensors); C5=Clinical/Population (EHR/surveys/neuropsych/cohorts/epidemiology); C6=Peripheral/Indirect markers (retinal/oculomics and other non-CNS scans linked to MCI)
Primary data modality. Be specific: T1-sMRI not just MRI; rs-fMRI not just fMRI; plasma GFAP not just biomarker
Model name and key design. Max 12 words. Include the specific architecture, not just 'deep learning'.
fields.example: 3D ResNet twin-branch + multi-level attention + spatial pyramid pooling

fields.description: T1=MCI vs HC current-state DISCRIMINATION; T2=pMCI vs sMCI conversion prediction; T3=multi-class staging HC/EMCI/LMCI/AD; T4=subtype/biomarker/correlational; T5=MCI reversion prediction; T6=clinical/population/review/descriptive
fields.normalisation_note: T1 vs T4 - THE DECIDING TEST IS WHETHER DISCRIMINATION IS QUANTIFIED, NOT WHETHER A HEALTHY CONTROL GROUP EXISTS. Assign T1 only when the study fits or evaluates a classifier, a diagnostic model or a cut-point and reports (or would report) a discrimination figure - accuracy, AUC, F1, sensitivity/specificity or kappa. A study that merely compares group MEANS between MCI and controls (t-test, ANOVA, effect size, correlation, odds ratio, "significant group difference") is T4, however central the MCI-vs-HC contrast is to its argument. Rationale: Task_Type is a COMPARABILITY GATE - agent4_relational.py gates both gap generation and complementary-finding generation on Task_Type equality, so pooling no-metric group-mean studies with fitted classifiers mints incommensurable comparisons. CAUTION: an existing Best_Metric of "not reported" is AMBIGUOUS and must not be used as the test on its own - it may mean the paper genuinely classifies nothing, or that an early extraction pass missed a real metric. Resolve from the summary block or the PDF; a paper that classifies but whose metric was never captured stays T1 and needs a Best_Metric fix instead. T2: map to T2 ONLY if the task is explicitly progressive vs stable MCI or MCI-to-AD conversion; do not map general MCI detection to T2. T5: reversion-to-normal PREDICTION only. Never use T5 for interventions, trials or reviews.
fields.boundary_decision: PAPERINGO-8ug, resolved 2026-08-11. Evidence: T1 rows carried a discrimination metric 89 per cent of the time (100/112) against 27 per cent for T4 (63/230); zero T4 rows were labelled task_substage=MCI_vs_HC while 86 of 112 T1 rows were, so the alternative reading had no existing constituency. Twelve legacy T1 rows lacked a discrimination metric; on audit against their summaries and PDFs, 8 were re-coded to T4 (P-17, P-87, P-364, P-421, P-447, P-451, P-563, P-762) and 4 were confirmed as genuine classification papers whose metric had simply never been extracted (P-143, P-150, P-160, P-306).

fields.description: Single best reported classification figure with metric type prefix. Format: TYPE VALUE. Never report without type prefix.
AUC value if reported, else NR. Do not compute AUC from sensitivity/specificity.
Primary dataset name(s). Use canonical names from normalisation rules. Include phase if ADNI.
Approximate total N. If per-class breakdown known, write as 'N_class1 + N_class2'. If N not reported, write NR.
V1=LOOCV small-n (<100); V2=k-fold CV same dataset no separate test set; V3=k-fold + held-out test partition; V4=external institutional validation (different institution or country)
fields.normalisation_note: If paper says 'train/test split' without external site, assign V3. If same dataset different fold, assign V2. Absence of reporting = V2 not V4.

fields.description: A1=traditional ML (SVM/RF/LR/XGBoost/NB); A2=CNN (1D/2D/3D/(2+1)D); A3=RNN/LSTM/GRU; A4=Transformer/attention; A5=GNN/GCN/GAT; A6=Ensemble (multi-family); A7=NLP/LLM-based; A8=Other/hybrid
Post-hoc explainability method used. Use canonical tags: Grad-CAM; SHAP; LIME; attention-map; occlusion; decision-tree; fuzzy-rules; none
The single most novel contribution. Max 12 words. Must distinguish this paper from prior work.
fields.example: First cross-lingual speech MCI pipeline; temporal pause features transfer cross-language

fields.description: The single most important acknowledged limitation. Max 12 words.
fields.example: Single-centre Chinese cohort; no prospective external validation

fields.description: Full journal name (not abbreviation). Conference papers: write 'Conference: [name]'. Preprints: write 'Preprint: [server]'.
Year of publication (not submission). Use online-first date if print date unavailable.
True if ADNI (any phase) is the primary or sole dataset. False if ADNI is used only for secondary comparison.
The fundamental study design regarding time points.
The specific task substage of progression.
Specific characteristics or diseases of the target population.
Subtype specific to the modality family (e.g., structural_MRI_only, trimodal_MRI_PET_CSF).
Prediction horizon for forecasting or survival analysis in years.
The type of the primary evaluation metric reported.
If this paper is a duplicate of another, the ID of the original paper.
Summary of explicitly stated open problems or future research directions in the paper. Extract from 'Open problems' section if present. Clean whitespace and truncate to 600 characters.
fields.example: Need larger multi-centre validation; lack of longitudinal data; unclear generalisation across demographics

extraction_prompt_template:
You are extracting structured metadata from an academic paper summary.
Return ONLY a valid JSON object with exactly the keys listed below.
If a field cannot be determined from the text, set its value to "not reported".
Do not infer, estimate, or fabricate any value.
For Task_Type: map to T2 ONLY if the task is explicitly progressive vs stable MCI or MCI-to-AD conversion.
For Validation_Type: absence of external site = V2 not V4.
For Best_Metric: always include the metric type prefix (Acc/AUC/bACC/F1/kappa).

Fields to extract: Paper_ID, Category, Modality, Method_Architecture, Task_Type, Best_Metric, Best_AUC, Dataset, Sample_N_Approx, Validation_Type, Architecture_Family, XAI_Method, Key_Novelty, Primary_Limitation, Journal, Publication_Year, ADNI_Dependent

Paper summary:
{summary_text}

Full text excerpt (methods + results):
{full_text_excerpt}
